card.name: Single lowercase letter starting a word
card.fires_on: A lone lowercase letter (c, r, n, l, k, t, d, w) that starts or abbreviates a word, often right after an opening bracket, quote, number or dash. It marks a spot where the rest of the word is still to come.

modes.label: Letter after bracket or quote
modes.description: A lowercase first letter of a word directly after an opening parenthesis or quotation mark.

modes.description: A lowercase unit or ordinal letter attached to a number.
